scope: Common detector input registry, frozen before model training and attack pilots

features.name: url_length
features.rule: Character count of the original URL string, including scheme, query, and fragment as stored.

features.name: no_of_slashes_inpath
features.rule: Count '/' characters in urlparse(url).path; query and fragment are excluded.

features.name: num_query_params
features.rule: Number of keys returned by urllib.parse.parse_qs(urlparse(url).query), using its default blank-value behavior.

features.name: numeric_proportion
features.rule: Count characters for which str.isdigit() is true in the original URL, divided by its character count; use 0 for an empty URL.

features.name: hostname_digit_ratio
features.rule: Reconstruct subdomain, domain, and suffix using pinned tldextract 5.2.0 with its bundled PSL and private suffixes disabled (matching the released extractor default); count ASCII digits in that reconstructed hostname and divide by its length; use 0 when empty.

features.name: url_entropy
features.rule: Shannon entropy in bits over the character-frequency distribution of the original URL; use 0 for an empty URL.

features.name: has_embedded_url
features.rule: 1 if the original URL contains more than one occurrence in total of the literal lowercase tokens 'http://' and 'https://'; otherwise 0.

features.name: no_of_forms
features.rule: Count form elements returned by BeautifulSoup 4.13.4 using the html.parser backend.

features.name: no_of_images
features.rule: Count img elements returned by BeautifulSoup 4.13.4 using the html.parser backend; the released column uses a capitalization variant.

features.name: has_missing_title
features.rule: 1 when the stripped, lowercased direct title string is missing or exactly one of index, home, page, or the empty string; otherwise 0.

features.name: has_inline_event_handlers
features.rule: 1 if any a or button element has a nonempty onclick or onmouseover attribute; otherwise 0.

decisions: The same frozen registry is used by both detector families.
Features requiring source lists, brand matching, ambiguous link-count semantics, or fitted phishing-only corpus statistics are excluded.
The released extractor is inspected as source only; it is not imported or executed.
The final split is not used for feature selection or recomputation tuning.

The released HTML feature columns no_of_Images, no_of_forms, and has_inline_event_handlers failed the development-sample source recomputation check; the PoC must regenerate these three from archived HTML for every record, never consume their released table values.
